messages:
alan: CSM flagged INV-2027-0304 from EchoGen — they were billed for both reserved instance and a preemptible replacement during a preemption event. Looks like double-charge.
risha: can you paste the invoice snippet and meter link?
alan: snippet below (trimmed):
```
line_id,pool_id,region,start,end,gpu_hours,unit_price
EG-2101,reserved-echogen-us,us-west-2,2027-03-04T11:00Z,2027-03-04T12:00Z,12.0,2.20
EG-2102,preemptible-replace,us-west-2,2027-03-04T11:05Z,2027-03-04T11:25Z,2.0,5.00
```
ops-bot: Meter export uploaded: s3://exports/echogen/2027-03/meter-0304.csv (sha1: cf7a1).
marta: infra note: host preempted at 11:05; autoscaler immediately spun up a preemptible replacement to keep customers online. Our metering pipeline currently treats reserved and preemptible as separate billable units even if replacement happened due to host preemption for the same committed workload.
risha: quick calc: extra = 2.0 * (5.00 - 2.20) = $5.60 net delta vs reserved rate, but customer was actually charged full $10.00 for preemptible line in invoice.
alan: customer expects we don't charge them extra when we replace a reserved instance with a temporary preemptible while we rebuild their reserved capacity. Contract says reserved commits cover compute for continuous capacity; preemptible replacements for host failures should not be billed to customer when they overlap reserved capacity.
finance-bot: Policy: bill adjustments for clear platform-caused replacements are allowed as provisional credits < $250 with ops + CSM approval. GL: PLATFORM_RECOVERY_CREDITS.
risha: propose issuing provisional credit CR-2027-044 for $10.00 now (full preemptible line) and open vendor claim VND-5003 to recover from host provider. Approve?
marta: approve. I'll add an eng ticket to change metering: when a preemptible instance is created within X minutes of a host preemption for the same pool and workload id, mark it as covered by reserve and emit zero-price line. Patch ETA 72h.
alan: created CR-2027-044 ($10.00) and applied to INV-2027-0304. Opened FIN-2027-112 to track vendor recovery. Vendor ticket VND-5003 created and assigned.
risha: sending customer note: "We've applied a provisional credit for the preemptible replacement charge while we pursue recovery from our host provider; engineering is adding a guard to avoid repeat billing."
vendor-bot: Vendor claim VND-5003 created and vendor ops requested host-side logs.
alan: customer replied and appreciated the transparency. Closing loop: provisional credit applied, vendor recovery in progress, eng mitigation planned. Will update FIN ticket when vendor responds. :white_check_mark:
